libOverrides.bundle.mjs: The synthesized entry transitively pulls in Next.js client internals (next/link, next/image, next/navigation) and app modules (src/lib/axios.ts) that reference a bare `process` global (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_*, process.env.__NEXT_*, process.platform, process.nextTick), which Next's webpack provides at build time but esbuild's browser bundle leaves unresolved, crashing every preview with 'process is not defined'. Fork adds `inject: [process-shim.mjs]` only; IIFE/header/footer contract unchanged.
libOverrides.process-shim.mjs: esbuild inject target for bundle.mjs's fork above — provides a minimal `process` global (env/platform/nextTick) so Next.js client internals pulled into the synthesized entry don't crash at bundle-init.
libOverrides.source-kit.mjs: The synth-entry fallback wrote `export * from <file>` for every source file, which does not re-export default exports. AppProviders/Logo/LanguageSwitcher/LegalDocumentShell are `export default function X()` and were silently missing from window.NixVetUI (broke cfg.provider — AppProviders resolved to undefined). Fork additionally emits `export { default as Name } from <file>` for files with a recoverable default export name; nothing else changed.
